claim: At commit baf1d20, DOM keydown/keyup events are translated by physical KeyboardEvent.code into T11 EV_KEY frames through direct or whole-machine-worker WasmLinux adapters. Each accepted transition calls sendKeyboardEvent followed by syncKeyboard; repeat and IME events are suppressed, dead keys remain physical, unknown/orphan events are explicit diagnostics/no-ops, and modifier releases are deferred until dependent keys break. The deterministic bridge and worker-protocol suite cover the acceptance and adversarial cases.
